verdict.rationale: The evidence shows static API reference pages (fleet, machine, ML training APIs) and a CLI that can call any API method. Nothing documents an interactive API reference with runnable, in-page examples, and the OpenAPI/Swagger probes all returned 404. Web UI test panels and CLI invocation are adjacent features, not an interactive API reference, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
